newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Orient-Avia boosts cargo 10 mnth factor.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Orient-Avia boosts cargo 10 mnth factor.

text.p: Private Russian airline ZAO Orient-Avia carried 138,900 passengers and 1,100 tonnes of mail and cargo during the first 10 months of this year, a big increase on the same period of 1995, a company spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
Yevgenia Semeryakova told Reuters the airline carried 86,000 passengers and 385 tonnes of mail and cargo between January and October of last year.
"The company cargo factor this year deals with only regular flights," she said.
In 1995 Orient-Avia carried total 100,000 passengers and 450 tonnes of cargo.
The Moscow-based carrier, established in 1994, operates four Ilyushin-62M jets on regular long-range routes between Moscow and Vladivostok and Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky in the Russian Far East.
The company's two Tupolev-134 short range planes service short domestic routes.
